extracted_data.document_summary: This study aimed to identify new genetic susceptibility loci for invasive epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) by performing a comprehensive meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies (GWAS). The investigation included data from general population EOC cases and controls, as well as BRCA1/2 mutation carriers. Six novel EOC susceptibility loci were discovered, and their potential functional roles were characterized through eQTL analysis, epigenetic profiling, gene expression and DNA copy number assessments, and in vitro transcriptional assays, with the ultimate goal of improving EOC risk prediction.

treatment_details.therapy_type: Genetic Risk Factor Identification and Functional Genomics Analysis (via Genome-Wide Association Studies, Meta-analysis, and In Vitro Transcriptional Assays)
treatment_details.dose_specificity: The study focused on identifying genetic risk factors for EOC, not a therapeutic intervention. A meta-analysis of approximately 11-11.4 million genetic variants was performed using data from 15,397-15,437 EOC cases (including 9,627 serous EOC), 30,816-30,845 controls, 15,252 BRCA1 mutation carriers (2,462 with EOC), and 8,211 BRCA2 mutation carriers (631 with EOC). Genome-wide significance for associations was set at p<5	10^-8. Functional analyses included gene expression analysis for 91 coding genes and mRNA expression for 316 complete tumors (Z-score threshold of 2), DNA copy number analysis for 481 serous EOC samples, and an in vitro luciferase reporter assay performed by co-transfecting 800 ng of luciferase constructs and 50 ng of pRL-TK Renilla into 8 	 10^4 iOSE4 normal ovarian cells. Methodological details included sample exclusion for genotyping call rate <95% and SNP exclusion based on imputation accuracy (r^2 <0.25-0.3) or minor allele frequency (MAF <0.005-0.01). Imputation utilized 90 MCMC iterations and specific buffer regions. No dose-response comparisons for a therapeutic treatment were reported.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: Associated with invasive EOC risk (p<5	10^-8). The lead SNP chr17:29181220:I showed an estimated HR for BRCA1 carriers significantly different from OCAC (p=0.005), while the association for BRCA2 carriers was consistent with OCAC (BRCA2-OCAC meta-analysis p=2.6	10^-9). A specific haplotype (rs9910051 and rs3764419) showed p=8.6	10^-8 for haplotype, and p=1.8	10^-8 for chr17:29181220:I in BRCA2-OCAC meta-analysis.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: ATAD5 acts as a tumor suppressor gene, modulating RAD9A/BCL2 interaction to induce DNA damage-related apoptosis; involved in DNA replication and repair, contributing to EOC susceptibility.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Susceptibility to invasive Epithelial Ovarian Cancer (EOC) in the general population (OCAC) and in BRCA1/BRCA2 mutation carriers, assessed via meta-analysis of GWAS data.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Indicates an increased genetic predisposition to invasive EOC; its incorporation into risk assessment tools can improve clinical risk predictions for BRCA1/2 mutation carriers.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: Associated with higher risk of all invasive EOC in meta-analysis (p<5	10^-8), with rs56318008 identified as the most strongly associated variant.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: WNT4 encodes a ligand in the WNT signaling pathway, critical for cell proliferation and differentiation; CDC42 plays a role in migration and signaling in ovarian/breast cancer; LINC00339 is implicated in endometriosis. This locus contributes to EOC susceptibility.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Susceptibility to all invasive EOC and increased risk of endometriosis in a meta-analysis including OCAC and BRCA1/BRCA2 carriers.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Indicates an increased genetic predisposition to invasive EOC and endometriosis, potentially improving clinical risk predictions for BRCA1/2 mutation carriers when incorporated into risk assessment tools.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: Associated with higher risk of all invasive EOC in meta-analysis (p<5	10^-8). The lead SNP rs58722170 showed stronger associations with the serous EOC subtype in OCAC (p=2.7	10^-12).

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: RSPO1 encodes R-spondin 1, involved in Wnt signaling, cell proliferation, tumorigenesis, and early ovarian development, regulating WNT4 expression. This gene contributes specifically to serous EOC subtype susceptibility.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Susceptibility to all invasive EOC, particularly serous EOC, in a meta-analysis including OCAC and BRCA1/BRCA2 carriers.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Indicates an increased genetic predisposition to invasive EOC, particularly the serous subtype, which can improve clinical risk predictions for BRCA1/2 mutation carriers when incorporated into risk assessment tools.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: Associated with higher risk of all invasive EOC in meta-analysis (p<5	10^-8); the lead SNP rs635634 is located upstream of the ABO gene.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: SYNPO2 (myopodin) is involved in actin filament organization, cell motility, and growth, with a reported tumor suppressor role. The ABO gene determines blood group and is associated with pancreatic cancer risk. This locus contributes to EOC susceptibility.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Susceptibility to all invasive EOC in a meta-analysis including OCAC and BRCA1/BRCA2 carriers.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Indicates an increased genetic predisposition to invasive EOC; its incorporation into risk assessment tools can improve clinical risk predictions for BRCA1/2 mutation carriers.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: Associated with higher risk of all invasive EOC in meta-analysis (p<5	10^-8).

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: The ABO gene is involved in blood group antigen determination. The locus is implicated in EOC risk, although a specific core biological function for the entire locus is not fully detailed within the provided text.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Susceptibility to all invasive EOC in a meta-analysis including OCAC and BRCA1/BRCA2 carriers.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Indicates an increased genetic predisposition to invasive EOC; its incorporation into risk assessment tools can improve clinical risk predictions for BRCA1/2 mutation carriers.

measured_effect.magnitude_quantification: Associated with higher risk, specifically for the serous EOC subtype, at genome-wide significance (p=3.0	10^-8 in meta-analysis for serous EOC); not significant for all invasive EOC (p=6.8	10^-6). The most significantly associated SNP was rs116133110.

analyzed_biomarkers.core_biological_function: GPX6 encodes an antioxidant enzyme; while its specific role in cancer is not detailed, this locus contributes specifically to serous epithelial ovarian cancer subtype susceptibility.
analyzed_biomarkers.relevant_activity_context: Susceptibility to serous EOC in a meta-analysis including OCAC and BRCA1/BRCA2 carriers.
analyzed_biomarkers.performance_or_health_indicator: Indicates an increased genetic predisposition to serous EOC; its incorporation into risk assessment tools can improve clinical risk predictions for BRCA1/2 mutation carriers.
